evidence.detail: The exact base-to-target diff contains 17 changed files: the device-code implementation, UI/API integration, tests, documentation, and governance records.
The isolated authentication suite completed successfully: 20 tests ran and passed.
The complete test command ran 34 tests, but nine server integration tests errored because the read-only review sandbox denied binding a loopback socket.
The required compile command could not create `__pycache__` in the read-only checkout and exited nonzero.
Governance validation could not create its temporary directory in this read-only environment and exited nonzero.
The implementation immediately clears the existing session and token before requesting a replacement device code, and generation checks prevent stale in-flight starts from reinstalling state.
The handoff records author-reported successful checks, but labels itself repair round 1 and reports 32 tests while the reviewed candidate is repair round 3 and currently discovers 34 tests.

evidence: Expected: independently executed full tests, compile, and governance validation must succeed against the exact target commit before a review can pass.

Observed: the authentication-only suite passed 20 tests, but the complete suite ended with nine socket-bind errors; compile failed because bytecode output was denied; governance validation failed because no writable temporary directory was available.
The author-reported successful results in project/handoffs/ISSUE-0002-handoff.md are claims rather than independently reproducible evidence in this review environment.
AGENTS.md requires BLOCKED whenever non-security evidence cannot be verified, and the launcher binding explicitly forbids PASS when execution fails.
findings.remediation: Rerun a fresh read-only Codex review in an environment that permits the required checks to bind loopback sockets and create disposable bytecode/temporary files, while preserving the exact reviewed SHA. Do not change product code solely to accommodate this review sandbox.

findings.verification: Confirm the handoff's repair round, candidate identity, changed files, test count, and check evidence all match the final reviewed commit and current suite.

limitations: The sandbox prohibited loopback socket binding, so nine server integration tests and the running application could not be exercised.
The read-only filesystem prevented `py_compile` from writing bytecode and prevented governance validation from creating temporary files.
No real Microsoft tenant sign-in was attempted; it is an explicitly protected action and an accepted residual evidence gap for this issue.
Static inspection found no additional substantive implementation defect, but successful end-to-end execution remains unverified.
review.summary: BLOCKED. Target identity and static implementation review are sound, and all 20 isolated authentication tests pass. The mandatory full test, compile, and governance checks cannot succeed in this read-only sandbox, and the committed handoff is stale for repair round 3.
